title: A rigid spectral invariant assigns Chern numbers to topological materials

statements.text: A spectral invariant $\kappa_{SC} = 815.2$ of Cayley graphs of $H_9$ yields a classification of physical systems by integer Chern number, whose values for twisted rhombohedral graphene, monolayer antimony and related materials ($C_n = +2, 0, +3, -1$) are stated to agree with 2026 measurements. A lattice algorithm offers a falsifiable check.

sources.quote: we demonstrate that the model’s exact predictions (C_n = +2, 0, +3, -1) are fully consistent with observed multi-layered quantum Hall metrics
